Largest single block at L_max=12 (irrep (3,6,3), dim 16940) × C^16 fiber = block-dim 271,040 → dense complex128 storage **1094.7 GB** (50× over the 17.1 GB VRAM cap); L_max=10 → **188.0 GB** (11× over); L_max=8 → **26.6 GB** (1.55× over — STILL infeasible for the single largest block). **Therefore full-spectrum diagonalization of D_K_PS at any L_max ≥ 8 is INFEASIBLE.** Crucially, the W6-1 axiom-4/KO-dim/K-theory *structural* test operates on the FINITE Pati-Salam Dirac `D_F` (≈32-dim per generation, ≈96-dim for 3 generations → dense storage ≈1.4e-4 GB), NOT on the Peter-Weyl-truncated full spectrum — exactly as the original `‖[[D_F,a],b°]‖ = 4.000` norm (C-6 FAIL, S28c) was a finite-D_F computation, not a full-spectrum one. PASS_meaning: >
  The Pati-Salam algebra extension CLOSES the order-one obstruction: axiom-4 defect < 1e-10 on the
  finite D_F^PS (and is preserved under inner fluctuation) AND KO-dim = 6 (BDI signs intact) AND
  K-theory/Poincaré-duality residual = 0. This is a DECISIVE structural result — it identifies the
  SOLE surviving STAGE-3 route for §VII.AQ.OP-PROJ (genuine algebra extension, NOT the §W9-1-closed
  quadratic counterterm) and opens the §VII.BE FWD-C4 Pati-Salam bridge for STAGE-3-PERMANENT
  promotion (the spectral-action Level-3 anchor still pending S94+ CF-W9-12-3 on the heavy spectrum).
  The substrate's gauge group becomes Pati-Salam SU(2)_L × SU(2)_R × SU(4)_C as a CONSEQUENCE of the
  NCG axioms + the observed particle spectrum, not an imposition.
FAIL_meaning: >
  The order-one obstruction PERSISTS under the SU(4)_C extension (defect ≥ 1e-10), OR KO-dim ≠ 6
  under the extended J_F/γ_F, OR the K-theory residual is non-zero. This CLOSES the last known
  STAGE-3 route for §VII.AQ.OP-PROJ: the order-one obstruction would then be ALGEBRA-INVARIANT
  across both the SM M_3(ℂ) and the Pati-Salam SU(4)_C extensions, establishing that no finite
  algebra extension in this family restores axiom-4. A FAIL is a permanent structural wall (the

  STRUCTURALLY-OPEN-BY-DESIGN at the order-one axis. FAIL is a result, not a setback.

  1-form basis is under-determined without a Yukawa-texture pin). The construction + the per-embedding
  defect table are pinned; the disambiguating Yukawa-texture / embedding choice is a pre-registered

    compute (the heavy ~3.0-we full-spectrum D_K_PS cache build is DEFERRED to S94+ CF-W9-12-3, NOT in
    this gate's scope). Effective in-session effort for the axiom-closure leg: ~1.0-1.5 we (finite
    spectral-triple construction + 7-axiom verification + inner-fluctuation order-one test + K-theory residual).

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC (chirality / order-one structure). The substrate IS the finite spectral triple; the
  question is whether the substrate's internal algebra is the SM-gauge A_K = ℂ ⊕ ℍ ⊕ M_3(ℂ) or its
  Pati-Salam parent A_K_PS = ℂ ⊕ M_2(ℂ)_L ⊕ M_2(ℂ)_R ⊕ M_4(ℂ)_PS. The order-one condition
  [[D_F^PS,a],b°]=0 is an AXIOM of the spectral triple (Connes 1996 reconstruction); its failure at
  norm 4.000 on the SM algebra (C-6, S28c) is the substrate's signal that the SM finite geometry is
  not the fundamental one. Direction substrate → emergent: the finite Dirac D_F^PS's bimodule
  structure → the order-one defect → the axiom-4 verdict → (on PASS) the emergent Pati-Salam gauge
  group SU(2)_L × SU(2)_R × SU(4)_C as a CONSEQUENCE of the axioms. The 4.000 obstruction "points to

  the minimal algebra extension that could restore order-one closure. We do NOT fit the algebra to a
  result; we test which algebra satisfies the axioms. The FULL spectral-action evaluation (the heavy
  Peter-Weyl spectrum) is a SEPARATE, deferred question — this gate is the axiom-CLOSURE test, the
  logically prior one: an algebra that fails axiom-4 cannot host a valid spectral action at all.

  the resolved regime identity). The honest-disclosure caveat carried verbatim at §W9-8 is RESOLVED.
FAIL_meaning: >

  the other does not), OR the regime-identity adjudication cannot exclude composite on a principled basis.
  §VII.BB stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the failing clause(s) route to S94+ remediation. A FAIL on the regime
  identity (e.g., if Axis-B argues the FB license is insufficient and the regime is genuinely ambiguous)
  is informative: it keeps the DEGENERATE-pole convergence identity OPEN and constrains the per-pole Level-1
  wall classification. FAIL is a result that maps the boundary, not a setback.
INFO_meaning: >
  Both axes PASS the substrate-IS structural clauses and the Level-3 anchor consistency, but the regime
  IDENTITY tie-break between FB-licensed (R²=0.865) and logarithmic-coherent (R²=0.953) is genuinely
  undecidable on the current 4-point L_max scan (both coherent, both non-power-law, neither uniquely

  finding is robust, but the FB-vs-log identity is pre-registered as an S94+ cross-pole-consistency (s3-vs-s5)
  carry-forward. §VII.BB advances on the saturating-regime robustness but the precise non-power-law form is
  INFO-deferred. (Per joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2" INFO criterion: an INFO clause keeps the theorem
  at Stage 1 with the INFO clause documented as Stage-2-INFO-deferred.)

PASS_meaning: >

  as §VII.BE co-author) independently PASS their single-axis clauses AND PASS-AND each JOINT clause (Kasparov KK
  morphism well-definedness + bridge-map-scheme-suffix discipline) AND the Level-3 anchor satisfies Level-3 <
  Level-2 envelope at canonical L_max — via the Friedrich-Bär η_FB^{SU(4)}=0.283 analytic bound on the feasible
  bottom-K SU(4)_PS sectors (route 4a). §VII.BE FWD-C4 advances STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligible
  (the framework's first GUT-extension cross-pillar bridge at STAGE-3). The mack sole-writer flip + the REGISTRY-
  INCOMPLETE-PENDING-FIRST-EXTRACTION sub-class discharge are follow-on registry-writes; this gate emits the
  Stage-2 PASS-AND verdict + the route-4a Level-3 bound.
FAIL_meaning: >
  Either cross-reviewer FAILs a single-axis clause, OR a JOINT clause fails to PASS-AND, OR (route 4a) the
  analytic Level-3 bound VIOLATES Level-3 < Level-2 (the bottom-K SU(4)_PS residue exceeds the L^{−3} envelope ⇒
  the SYMBOLIC α(PS)=3 inheritance is wrong for the rank-4 block, e.g. the SU(4) Peter-Weyl combinatorics give a
  different exponent). §VII.BE stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the failing clause routes to S94+ remediation. A FAIL on
  the Level-3 bound is informative: it shows the rank-4 lepton-color block's convergence is NOT simply inherited
  from the rank-3 SM calibration, constraining the FWD-C4 algebraic-envelope independence (HIT criterion iv).
INFO_meaning: >
  BOTH axes PASS the JOINT clauses but the Level-3 anchor cannot be evaluated analytically (route 4a infeasible:
  the bottom-K SU(4)_PS sectors alone do not bound the residue without the full cache, OR the Friedrich-Bär SU(4)
  extension is not yet certified) — so route 4b is taken: Level-3 < Level-2 is verified SYMBOLICALLY (α(PS)=3 <
  L_max^{−3}) and the NUMERICAL Level-3 pin is DEFERRED to S94+ CF-W9-12-3 (the D_K_PS spectrum cache build,
  ~4.0 we, INFEASIBLE in-session at 1094 GB full-spectrum). §VII.BE advances to STAGE-3-eligible CONDITIONAL on
  the S94 Level-3 numerical anchor. This is the HONEST verdict given the pre-checked full-spectrum infeasibility:
  the Stage-2 cross-axis structural verification is complete, but the empirical Level-3 anchor is a deferred
  substrate-physics compute (the DEFER is a feasibility wall, not a methodology choice — per agent-standards.md
  honest-disclosure + math-scripts.md §D_K Block-Diagonality Pre-Check).
